commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Filip Jorgensen is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
85' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
82' 3 - 2 Iago Aspas launches a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. 3:2.
82' Filip Jorgensen pulls off a great save to deny Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
80' Here is a change. Fran Beltran is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Carles Perez (Celta Vigo).
80' The substitution has been made. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) has replaced Hugo Alvarez.
80' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
79' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Dani Parejo is replaced by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal).
78' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Goncalo Guedes leaves the pitch and Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) comes on.
73' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
69' Golden opportunity! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
65' 2 - 2 Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes into the top right corner.
65' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Williot Swedberg and he is replaced by Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
65' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
62' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) tackles a bit over-zealously and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
60' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close!
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
56' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Ilias Akhomach will be replaced by Francis Coquelin (Villarreal).
56' Substitution. Alberto Moreno makes way for Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).
54' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
53' The Villarreal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
48' The attendance for today's match is 19548.
46' It's time for a substitution. Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) comes on in place of Javier Manquillo.
46' We are about to witness a substitution. Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is replacing Damian Rodriguez.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marcelino probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Yerson Mosquera. He is replaced by Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' The opposition give Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

40' 2 - 1 Damian Rodriguez showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the middle of the goal. It's 2:1.
39' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
39' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
37' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Filip Jorgensen is alert and denies him.
37' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
36' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
35' Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
31' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
29' Some neat passing and movement from Villarreal as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
25' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
22' 1 - 1 Goal! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Filip Jorgensen to commit before slotting the penalty into the middle of the goal.
22' PENALTY to Celta Vigo!
17' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Santi Comesana (Villarreal) has to leave the pitch!

16' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Santi Comesana (Villarreal), but referee Cesar Soto Grado must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
15' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.

12' 0 - 1 Goal! Dani Parejo finds Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the right side of the goal. Fantasy football! 0:1.
8' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
6' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) attempts to feed Kiko Femenia with a chip pass, but Vicente Guaita reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
3' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
3' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half has started.
Villarreal will kick the game off.
Cesar Soto Grado was nominated as the referee for this game.
